items.quote: Joyce Kiddell: for fraud that automatically changes the fraud review status to suspected um but then doesn't do anything to like the core / Kobi Kunasekaran: Basically, the main the main status for a signup is new, in progress, and completed. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Um, but within the completed, we'll have a sub status uh for or like a some way to identify anything that's flagged as fraud. / Kobi Kunasekaran: there's no more action that a rep can do until that fraud flag is lifted which will be done by somebody in ops and when they lift the fraud flag then the signup can go back to / Kobi Kunasekaran: in progress and then rep can work on it. / Lina Ceniccola: perfect.
items.supersedes_hint: Replaces Flagged as a step in the status path (five statuses: new, in progress, completed, archived, flagged)

items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: we would essentially need like an API endpoint with like what are the fields that you need and then we can we can set up the payloads and try uh we can try build a PLC to test it out. / Kobi Kunasekaran: you need to tell us like what fields you need on the CMS side / Joyce Kiddell: we'll just like take screenshots. / Kobi Kunasekaran: So as we're creating the Dorup assignments, we would make an API call out to your CMS.
items.asr_note: Durup/deor/Dorup/direct assignment = deal rep assignment [ASR?]; PLC = POC [ASR?]

items.topic: SLC deal-determination fields already documented
items.statement: Kobi said the fields needed to determine the deal from study link clicks were already in the document he shared.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I think for the for the deals to be able to from the study click links determine what the deal is. I think those are the fields. I believe those were already in the document that I shared.

items.topic: WagerTech to try Salesforce mobile app
items.statement: Waleed suggested trying the Salesforce mobile app (layouts translate without custom mobile work); Joyce said they will download it.
items.quote: Waleed Alasadi: have you guys downloaded the Salesforce app yet and like tried to do this through your cell phone? / Kobi Kunasekaran: We're not building anything custom that we have to then also specifically make sure it works for mobile. / Joyce Kiddell: But um yeah, we'll definitely download the app.

items.topic: Emily to give feedback on other screens
items.statement: Emily said WagerTech will provide more feedback on other screens and help with the status codes.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: We will get you the kind of like some of these some more feedback on some of the other screens and then those status codes I have to help as well.

items.topic: Fields for signup completion percentage
items.statement: Autocompleting signups is still an open decision; regardless, WagerTech must confirm which fields are required for the signup completion percentage (listed in the open questions).
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: last time we talked about whether we want to autocomplete signups. Um, and I I know that was like a decision point. / Kobi Kunasekaran: we need to know what are all the required information for that. So, I I put them in the uh in the open question. So, if you can just confirm what those are, um, that would be great.

items.topic: No time on user-input date fields
items.statement: User-input date fields will drop the time component; inherited/system timestamps (e.g. click timestamp) keep time. Kobi agreed.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: So if we can drop the time it it'll make the interface a lot cleaner. / Joyce Kiddell: like for anything that a user has to input, I wouldn't put a time. But if there's like inherited fields like the the time stamp that comes with a click, / Joyce Kiddell: for example, I would include the time / Kobi Kunasekaran: users input there's no time okay that works

items.topic: Storage scope update after GCP change
items.statement: Emily listed a storage scope update (Jumpr had taken it away because of the GCP update) on the agenda. It was not discussed in the meeting, so the update is still open.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: Um storage scope, I know you were taking that away um just with the GCP update. So just an update there.

items.topic: WagerTech referral logic addition not discussed
items.statement: Emily said WagerTech has an addition to the referral logic to talk through. It was not discussed in the meeting; the content of the addition is unknown.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: Um referral logic, we have a bit of an addition I would say there. So we can kind of talk through that.

items.topic: API user permissions believed set; WagerTech backend changing
items.statement: Kobi said he thinks Jumpr made sure all permissions (including on custom objects) are accurate for the sandbox integration and asked WagerTech to message if their developer has trouble creating records. Emily said a lot is changing on WagerTech's back end and the developer needs to familiarize himself.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I think we did we made sure like all made sure all the permissions are accurate but just in case just in case he has any trouble like creating records or anything just yeah shoot us a message we'll jump on / Emily Vandenberg: Yeah. And and he will there's a lot's changing on our back end so I think he just has to familiarize.

items.topic: Log Signup button naming
items.statement: Joyce's mockup had 'sign up' and 'archive' actions; Kobi named the action 'Log Signup' and invited WagerTech to suggest better terminology. No name was confirmed.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I you had like sign up and archive. I called it log signup. Um I can also call it signup. Um or if there's like a better terminology um that we can come up with, let me know.

items.topic: Emily to re-ping feedback tracker
items.statement: Emily asked if Kobi had looked at the feedback tracker in parallel with the working sessions; Kobi said he did but treated the working-session feedback as the latest. Emily said she will re-ping him because the points were outlined in the tracker.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: Yeah. Kobe, did you look at the feedback tracker as well in parallel to the like the working sessions we / Kobi Kunasekaran: I did. Yeah. / Kobi Kunasekaran: But I treated this as like the latest feedback though. / Emily Vandenberg: but it's it's like I'll just reping you, but we had outlined it.

items.topic: Remove duplicate fields from view
items.statement: Joyce said fields that show up in multiple spots on the screen can be removed from the view, while single-instance fields are fine to keep. Kobi acknowledged.
items.quote: Joyce Kiddell: Okay. And if there's fields that show up kind of in multiple spots on the screen, / Joyce Kiddell: like that's when I think we can just like remove it from the view. You know what I mean? But like if there's one time instances and that's fine. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah. Okay. Okay.

items.topic: CMS control vs two-way assignment sync
items.statement: Emily said the CMS will only receive deal rep assignment information and nobody can turn assignments on or off from the CMS, to avoid the Airtable problem. Joyce said two-way would be ideal but she needs to understand the extra effort and what data is available through the CMS. Not resolved.
items.quote: Emily Vandenberg: So CMS will only receive the information and do the action. / Emily Vandenberg: No. And then like nobody can actually turn on and off from the CMS is the claim that we'll make, right? Cuz it's just going to run into the same problem we have with Air / Joyce Kiddell: Yeah. Like I think 2A would be ideal. / Joyce Kiddell: I just need to understand like is it a lot more effort that way like what data is available through the CMS to kind of manage

items.topic: CMS can query any SF field via REST API
items.statement: Jumpr stated that for inbound queries the CMS uses the standard Salesforce REST API, so any field (including fields not on the UI) is available with nothing special to build; Waleed said the CMS can collect any field on the deal rep assignment object through the API.
items.quote: Waleed Alasadi: I think it's all the you can collect any of the fields on the direct assignment object. um at ruin API. / Kobi Kunasekaran: we're just using like Salesforce uh REST API right so anything that's available uh not just in the UI but even like uh any fields that we create that's uh behind the scenes there's nothing special we have to do for that to be available if what you're doing is uh querying Salesforce through the rest API
items.asr_note: direct assignment = deal rep assignment [ASR?]; at ruin API = through the API [ASR?]

items.topic: Reports allow inline edits, no actions
items.statement: Kobi said reports allow inline field edits but he does not think actions can be run from them; list views can enable search and inline editing. Reps must click into the record to use action buttons.
items.quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: they can yeah they can uh they can do inline field edits. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Um don't think you can do any actions. / Kobi Kunasekaran: So in a list view you can you can you can search for people um you can enable inline editing so they can actually edit certain fields directly in here. / Kobi Kunasekaran: It doesn't have buttons or anything though, but um like but they can use it to click in and go into the record itself to do the actions.

items.topic: Polish limited to colours and buttons
items.statement: Joyce clarified she does not want to change the out-of-box layout; the polish she wants is subtle, such as different colours or button colours to draw the eye. No confirmation from Jumpr beyond acknowledgement.
items.quote: Joyce Kiddell: It's more just like, you know, making colors like a different or making buttons different colors or like just subtle things to kind of bring your / Joyce Kiddell: eye somewhere, you know?

items.topic: In-progress fraud review queue; reps see but cannot act
items.statement: Lina said WagerTech's new welcome-email/fraud detection will include a dedicated person reviewing incoming fraud at the In Progress step, which is new. Reps should see signups under fraud but cannot act on them until ops moves the status back to In Progress, or the signup becomes a write-off/permanent fraud.
items.quote: Lina Ceniccola: But with the new system that we're building to detect like welcome emails and / Lina Ceniccola: and fraud detection, whatnot, we'll we'll have a queue someone dedicated to like reviewing incoming fraud to catch it in the in progress step, which we haven't had before. / Lina Ceniccola: Yeah. Like the rep the rep should see what's under prod. / Lina Ceniccola: they can't action it until ops is like puts the status back to in progress in their queue.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Re-introduction of linear status path The linear path displaying "New," "In Progress," and "Completed" statuses will be re-introduced to the user interface.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Joyce Kiddell: I I think we can introduce it again. / Waleed Alasadi: then maybe we just don't show the path and just keep the status like field as is.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary lists path re-introduction as Aligned. Joyce conditionally supported it, but after Archived was kept in the status field Waleed suggested not showing the path; no final decision was confirmed.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Salesforce to CMS integration direction Salesforce will serve as the source of truth for deal assignments, pushing relevant data to the CMS via an API endpoint.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Joyce Kiddell: Salesforce into the CMS I would say to start that's where everything will / Joyce Kiddell: I just feel like there's a lot of discussion we need to have around this I I don't have a confident / Emily Vandenberg: Okay. Well, let's just nail that down.
gemini_disagreements.why: Summary states it as an aligned decision. Joyce said 'to start' and then said she is not confident and more discussion is needed; Emily said to nail it down. Firmer than transcript.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: The team also agreed to adopt the Salesforce mobile application for native accessibility.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Waleed Alasadi: Um it's worth looking at. / Joyce Kiddell: But um yeah, we'll definitely download the app.
gemini_disagreements.why: Transcript only commits WagerTech to download and look at the app; no agreement to adopt the mobile app.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Queue Terminology: Kobi Kunasekaran proposed renaming the "New" list to "In Progress" to better align with the status workflow.
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: I called it Q just to mimic like what we had here, but I'm thinking maybe we need to call this like in progress
gemini_disagreements.why: Misattributed list: the rename was for the Q list view, not the New list (Details section; the Decisions section has it right).

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: UI Mockup Review: Lina Ceniccola shared a mockup for the interface layout. The team reached a consensus on the visual presentation and agreed to include color-coded statuses on the left-hand side of the queue (00:43:55).
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Joyce Kiddell: Yeah, I think we even had colorcoded statuses on the left. / Lina Ceniccola: Can we do this or you know close to this? / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah. Do we do we want the path
gemini_disagreements.why: Lina asked 'Can we do this or close to this?' and Jumpr did not explicitly confirm; conversation moved to the path question. Details section is firmer than the transcript.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Archiving and Fraud status structure The system will implement separate 'Archived' and 'Fraud' statuses, removing the 'Flagged' category and providing unique reason lists for each. (Also Summary: 'They agreed to split the Flagged category into Fraud and Archived'.)
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: Basically, the main the main status for a signup is new, in progress, and completed. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Um, but within the completed, we'll have a sub status uh for or like a some way to identify anything that's flagged as fraud. / Kobi Kunasekaran: Yeah. So remove flagged from the status will keep archived.
gemini_disagreements.why: Transcript keeps Archived as a status but tracks fraud separately (fraud review status / sub-status / checkbox), not as a 'Fraud' status value. Summary inverts this into a Fraud status.

gemini_disagreements.summary_text: Flagging and Fraud Categories: Kobi Kunasekaran proposes splitting the existing "Flagged" status into distinct "Fraud" and "Archived" categories to differentiate general exclusions...
gemini_disagreements.transcript_quote: Kobi Kunasekaran: in the PRD we've com uh the fraud and invalid reasons are both together and based on this new process we're kind of splitting them up right.
gemini_disagreements.why: Kobi proposed splitting the reason lists (fraud vs invalid/archive reasons) from the PRD, not splitting the Flagged status into two status categories.
